ETS2-v2.0.0.description:
⚠ **This release is not backwards compatible with 1.1.0! Do not update if you have a game in progress!** See [here](https://github.com/Nixill/APManual-ETS2/blob/main/changelogs/1.59-migration.md) for downgrade or migration guide.

# APWorld changes
The following changes were made to the APWorld:
- Added option `secret_road_checks`. When disabled (which is the default), viewpoints on secret roads are not checks.
  - For a list of viewpoints affected by this, see [this file](https://github.com/Nixill/APManual-ETS2/blob/main/changelogs/2.0.0_secret_road_checks.md#changed), kept separate for spoiler reasons.
- Removed EuroAcres from Luxembourg; the company did not actually have a location there, but the apworld incorrectly stated that it did, affecting generation logic.

# Game changes
The following changes were made to Euro Truck Simulator 2 itself and reflected in the APWorld:

## Companies
- Added **DAF Trucks**, with locations in the Netherlands, United Kingdom, France (Vive la France !), Spain (Iberia), Norway (Scandinavia and Nordic Horizons), Finland (Nordic Horizons), Russia (Beyond the Baltic Sea), Estonia (Beyond the Baltic Sea), Romania (Road to the Black Sea), Greece (Greece), and Italy (Italia)
- Added **Euro Flow Ports**, only in Belgium.
- Added **Stronghold**, only in the Netherlands.
- Added **Suikersmij**, only in the Netherlands.

## Cities
- Added **Antwerp** in Belgium.
- Added **Eindhoven** in the Netherlands.

## Company Locations
- Added **CNP**, **Container port**, **Ika Bohag**, **ITCC**, **Kathode**, **NS Oil**, **Primel**, and **TDC Auto Terminal** to the Netherlands.
- Removed **Kaarfor**, **Trameri**, and **TransiNet** from the Netherlands.
- Added **Container port**, **Sanbuilders**, **SellPlan**, **Shuttle Cola**, **Steinbruch**, and **WGCC** to Belgium.
- Removed **EuroAcres**, **ITCC**, and **Stokes** from Belgium.
- Added **Primel** and **SellPlan** to Luxembourg.

## Photo Trophies
- Added **Amsterdam Venue**, **Lonje Windmill**, **Pesse Gas Station**, **Van Brienenoord Bridge**, and **Zuidas District** to the Netherlands.
- Removed **Amsterdam Panorama** from the Netherlands.
- Added **Antwerpen-Centraal Railway Station**, **Liege-Guillemins Railway Station**, and **Wanlin Rest Stop** to Belgium.
- Removed **Basilica of the Sacred Heart** from Belgium.
- Added **Philharmonie Luxembourg** to Luxembourg.
- Removed **State Bank and Savings Fund** from Luxembourg.

## Viewpoints
- Added **Eindhoven**, **Groningen**, and **De Vlieter** to the Netherlands.
- Added **La Roche-en-Ardennes** and **Antwerp** to Belgium.
- Added two secret viewpoints, viewable [here](https://github.com/Nixill/APManual-ETS2/blob/main/changelogs/2.0.0_secret_road_checks.md#added).
ETS2-v2.0.0.title: ETS2 v2.0.0 - The Real 1.59 Update

ETS2-v4.0.0.description:
This is a near complete rewrite of the Checks Reduction™ system to actually properly function, including taking into account the percent of state count as well as items that you need to keep.

I don't know if it's backwards compatible with existing AP games. It should be, but just to be safe I'm bumping the major version number here.

v1.0.1.description:
Initial\* release of Euro Truck Simulator 2 for Manual!

View the [README](https://github.com/Nixill/APManual-ETS2#readme) for setup instructions.

Since this is heavily inspired by [dopinpt's version](https://github.com/dopinpt/ETS2Manual), here's a changelog from that:

- Added Nordic Horizons DLC
- Added some previously missing cities
- Added new victory conditions, "Secret Deliveries Completed" or "Player Level Checks Cleared"
  - Secret Deliveries Completed requires opening your patch file to read text files within. A tool to read them online is in the works.
- Locked the following abilities behind items in the multiworld (though, under default settings, these items start in your inventory):
  - Buying trucks
  - Buying trailers
  - Taking a loan from the bank
  - Using ferries (this does not count the Channel Tunnel train)
  - Performing Photosanity or Viewpointsanity checks
  - Quck traveling to new areas
  - Assigning your skill points to skills
- Added options to:
  - Set the starting location to a different country than Germany
  - Choose whether the item is in your inventory, Sphere 1, or anywhere in the multiworld, for all of the items mentioned above
  - Disable Cities as locations
  - Enable Companies or Level-ups as locations
  - Reduce the number of locations

The default settings of this version of the Manual are identical to dopinpt's version, with the exception that there are 25 delivery tokens placed in the multiworld instead of 20 (getting 20 is still the goal, though).

\*v1.0.1 is a hotfix because apparently GitHub doesn't support asset files with spaces in the filename - the internal file structure had to change to match that.
v1.0.1.title: ETS2 v1.0.1 - Initial* Release
